name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost brings back the simplicity and efficiency of the traditional WordPress editor while enhancing it with powerful, modern features.
If you love the straightforwardness of the traditional editor but need more tools to streamline your workflow, DominoPost is the perfect solution.
It provides a familiar interface with new productivity tools, neatly organized in their own toolbar row:

  • NEW! Title Case Fixer: Quickly change the case of your post title.
    Click the “Aa” button next to the title to apply Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, or Capitalized Case directly to the post title.
  • Post Content Case Fixer: Quickly change the case of your selected post content.
    No more manual re-typing—just select your text and choose from Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, or Capitalized Case.
  • Enhanced! Copy Code Block: Easily create copyable code or text blocks.
    When you click the button, you can now add a title (like ‘html’ or ‘note’) which is displayed in a clean, modern header on the frontend, complete with a “Copy code” button.
  • Table of Contents (TOC): Instantly generate a dynamic, auto-updating Table of Contents based on the headings in your post.
    Customize the style (bullets, numbered, or collapsible) right from the sidebar.
    Our goal is to provide a minimal-friction editing experience that feels native to WordPress but is packed with the extra power you need.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopost-advanced-post-editor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page to start using the new DominoPost features.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0 – 2025-11-20

  • Added “Rate Plugin” link on the Plugins page.
  • Enhanced stability of tracking and security alerts.
  • Optimized deactivation process.

1.1.0 – 2025-10-30

  • New Feature: Added a “Title Case Fixer” menu directly to the post title field.
  • New Feature: Added an opt-in anonymous tracking notice on plugin activation to help improve the plugin.
  • Enhancement: Redesigned the “Copy Code Block” output. It now features a clean header with a custom title and a “Copy code” button in a modern, light-theme box.
  • Enhancement: Updated the “Copy Code Block” in the editor to prompt the user for a title.
  • Enhancement: The in-post “Copy Code” block now uses a normal font for better readability of plain text, not just code.
  • UI Cleanup: Moved all DominoPost editor buttons (TOC, Case Fixer, Copy Code) to their own dedicated 3rd-row toolbar, prefixed with a “DominoPost” label to reduce clutter.

1.0.0 – 2025-10-02

  • Initial release.
  • Provides a streamlined interface.
  • Adds Table of Contents and Post Content Case Fixer tools to the editor toolbar.
  • Includes sidebar options for TOC customization.
